南洋廳統計年鑑 1939

Nan'yōchō tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the South Seas Government), 第九回 (No. 9), figures mainly for 昭和10–14 (1935–1939), published 昭和16年8月 (August 1941)
南洋廳內務部企畫課, パラオ (昭和十六年)

All 179 numbered tables are transcribed, with the appendix table of weights and measures (度量衡比較表); the contents, the statistical charts (統計圖表), the maps and the colophon are not. The contents list the tables without chapter headings; chapters are assigned from the 總目次 start pages and, where a table shares a chapter's first page, from the running heads. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading was used; every such cell was then re-read by a reader who had not seen the first reading, and cells the second reader could not confirm are marked [?]. Figures are kept exactly as printed, including points, spaces or other marks printed where a comma or decimal point is expected. Small figures printed above a cell (foreigners, quantities) are given in the same cell after the figure; in the trade, agriculture and fisheries tables many of these small quantities and unit marks are too blurred to read and are marked [?]. No errata slip was found in this copy. About 550 of some 74,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
